end.summary:
Discussed why objects float or sink.
Practised that material matters, not only weight or size.
Yash correctly classified coins, stones, spoons, caps, leaves, and wood.
Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting objects by whether they float or sink and focusing on the material they are made from. Yash correctly identified several examples, including steel and stone sinking and wood, cork, leaves, and plastic caps floating. At first, they linked sinking and floating mainly to heaviness; this was corrected later when they explained that material matters. At home, compare two objects of different materials and ask Yash to predict and explain what will happen in water.
